summary: What's left is one number everywhere, every command runs as printed, and phone apps skip the jargon questions.
notes: What's left is one number, the same in every command and in Mission Control, with a new After you group for the steps launchpad finishes once you've done yours.
Every command launchpad gives you runs exactly as printed, as a slash command in Claude Code or in a terminal.
For phone apps, launchpad proposes your app's ID and reads your Firebase values itself instead of asking for them.
Before the first apply, you see every file it will create or change, and it asks you once.
A key that is no longer active says so plainly, with what to send to support.

beta.summary: Every card shows one clear way to do it, and new versions arrive as a proper update window.
notes: Each to-do shows the quickest way first; other ways sit under one fold, each marked as an alternative.
A card launchpad can do itself says so, with one Do it button.
New versions open a window with the release notes and Update now, Later or Skip this version.
A newer update is never hidden behind an older notice.
Buys through a test checkout: you are not charged.
